canonical_state.health_contract: GREEN validation with complete transaction history

workbook_role: Durable history, context and human-readable reporting; never a substitute for newer valid CBS state.

translations.continuous_operation: Treat all GBO chats as one baseball operation governed by shared doctrine, current CBS state and the GBO ledger.
translations.semantic_authority: CBS controls platform-recorded ownership, availability, salary, cap, standings, roster status and transactions at its timestamp; Grant controls intent and corrections.
translations.temporal_alignment: Compare CBS captures and transactions by their effective timestamps before treating ownership, salary or roster-status claims as inconsistent.
translations.retrieval_vs_uncertainty: Retain the newest successful GREEN CBS state when capture or retrieval fails; label freshness limits without inventing state uncertainty.
translations.canonical_state_first: Read the GBO manifest and compact front-office projections before loading the full CBS snapshot or workflow diagnostics.
translations.state_evaluation_separation: Resolve roster, salary, cap, IL, minors and pool completeness before evaluating baseball talent or move quality.
translations.availability_proof: Audit the complete current CBS available pool and verify every plausible should-not-be-available player before waiver advice.
translations.layered_evaluation: Translate production, rates, role, health and consensus through CBS scoring, eligibility, salary, annual $3 escalation, cap, IL and minors rules.
translations.discovery_vs_urgency: Balance prospect or role-change signals against keeper cost, cap, exact drop and IL or minors alternatives.
translations.executable_recommendations: Include exact drop, maximum bid, player salary, cap effect and active, reserve, IL or minors path.
translations.state_lineage_identity: Use CBS player IDs and the complete CBS transaction chain; keep present roster state distinct from the historical transaction record.
translations.roster_optionality: Optimize IL and minors capacity within eligibility and cap rules, without stashing merely for activity.
translations.post_move_writeback: Update the GBO ledger, confirmed overrides and roster or cap implications after each confirmed move before further advice.
translations.actionable_monitoring: Prioritize lineup, pitching, waiver, IL-stash, prospect, international and realistic trade implications.
translations.cross_sport_propagation: Apply shared organizational lessons through baseball rules, data, schedules, contracts and roster mechanics; never import football state.
translations.lean_architecture: Keep CBS collection, ingest, projection and interpretation as separate single-owner responsibilities with thin orchestration.
translations.durability_versioning: Use the latest valid CBS canonical state and latest shared doctrine; retain older workbooks and snapshots as historical evidence only.
